product_one_liner.value: Design Arena lets creators generate and compare AI-produced websites, apps and multimedia, while helping AI developers benchmark models using real-world human preferences.
product_one_liner.notes: The product profile describes generating and comparing websites, apps and multimedia; YC describes evaluating models on real-world design tasks with users. Sources: https://www.designarena.ai/profile and https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/design-arena.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation or footer, and the tested pricing route returned only a self-redirect rather than plans or pricing content. Source: https://www.designarena.ai/. The redirect makes this a qualified negative.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Index Ventures' company write-up explicitly says Google used Design Arena to test Gemini 3 and OpenAI used it to evaluate models. These names are based on documented product use, not investor status or provider logos; paid-contract status is not disclosed. Source: https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/proving-ai-in-the-real-world-our-investment-in-the-intelligence-company. | named_customers.0: The company write-up explicitly says Google used Design Arena to test Gemini 3 ahead of launch. It establishes product use, although payment is not disclosed: https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/proving-ai-in-the-real-world-our-investment-in-the-intelligence-company. | named_customers.1: The company write-up explicitly includes OpenAI among organizations using Design Arena to evaluate models. It establishes product use, although payment is not disclosed: https://www.indexventures.com/perspectives/proving-ai-in-the-real-world-our-investment-in-the-intelligence-company.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company record reports 12 employees, placing it in 11-20. This is a profile count, not an audited payroll total: https://linkedin.com/company/design-arena-ai.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The matching G2 listing explicitly gives HQ Location: San Francisco, US: https://www.g2.com/sellers/design-arena. | hq_country: The matching G2 listing identifies HQ Location: San Francisco, US and links designarena.ai: https://www.g2.com/sellers/design-arena.

founded_year.notes: The Y Combinator profile explicitly lists Founded: 2025: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/design-arena.

eng_blog.notes: At least two posts explain product implementation: slide-generation harnesses and mobile-agent evaluation infrastructure. They appear in technical cofounder Grace Li's author archive, and YC identifies her computer-science background. Her engineering authorship is supported by technical content and background rather than an explicit engineer job title. Sources: https://notes.designarena.ai/what-weve-learned-from-50-000-ai-slides-generations-open-sourced-for-you-today-2/; https://notes.designarena.ai/evaluating-mobile-app-building-agents/; https://notes.designarena.ai/author/grace/; https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/design-arena.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation links multiple resources, including Quickstart, API Reference and Leaderboard Endpoint: https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live ML Engineer posting and the current careers listing for Member of Technical Staff, ML Research Engineer satisfy the title requirement. Sources: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/intelligence/3de9ad79-9225-4aed-bb0f-8a9830818a8d and https://intelligence.ai/careers.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and Mistral; NVIDIA Llama 3.1 Nemotron Ultra 253B via OpenRouter.
model_provider.notes: The technical blog explicitly lists OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI and Mistral as supported providers. The changelog names NVIDIA's model via OpenRouter. Sources: https://notes.designarena.ai/evaluating-mobile-app-building-agents/ and https://www.designarena.ai/changelog.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 specifically for its cloud infrastructure providers, not as certifications independently held by Design Arena; the answer preserves that limitation: https://www.designarena.ai/security. | compliance_certs.0: https://www.designarena.ai/security names SOC 2 for its cloud hosting providers, not Design Arena's own certification. | compliance_certs.1: https://www.designarena.ai/security names ISO 27001 for its cloud hosting providers, not Design Arena's own certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both the founder announcement and funding report explicitly call the latest located financing a seed round. Sources: https://x.com/grx_xce/status/2084361692792934488 and https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/03/designarena-creators-raise-7-9-million-to-bring-taste-to-ai-models. | funding_date: The seed round was announced August 3, 2026, yielding 2026-08. Sources: https://x.com/grx_xce/status/2084361692792934488 and https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/03/designarena-creators-raise-7-9-million-to-bring-taste-to-ai-models. | funding_amount_usd: The founder announcement and TechCrunch report identify the latest located round as $7.9 million, converted to 7900000 USD. raised_18mo.notes: The founder's August 3, 2026 announcement confirms a $7.9 million seed raise within the requested 18-month window: https://x.com/grx_xce/status/2084361692792934488.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable careers page lists ML Research Engineer, Platform and Founding Launch Designer, but no SDR, BDR or account executive opening: https://intelligence.ai/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced and open-sourced its slide-generation implementation on July 10, 2026, within the six-month window. This is a substantive technical release rather than a cosmetic update. Sources: https://notes.designarena.ai/ and https://notes.designarena.ai/what-weve-learned-from-50-000-ai-slides-generations-open-sourced-for-you-today-2/.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: no dated C-level or VP joining/departure announcement was established. The About page is methodology rather than a leadership history, and the YC founder roster does not provide start dates sufficient to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable careers page and public API documentation name no CRM or sales/marketing system, supporting an empty list rather than unknown. Sources: https://intelligence.ai/careers and https://docs.designarena.ai/introduction.
